attribution_method: Count the union of sized machine-code intervals after folding. Group by the outer demangled symbol, using shared buckets for ambiguous aliases. FDE records and their search index follow the start address. Exception-table entries span from one referenced LSDA address to the next, including alignment and distinguishing shared spans. The disjoint subtotal is .text plus these three unwind sections. Relocated pointer slots, the code they address, training coverage and repeated shapes are separate views and must not be added to it.

relro_distinct_exact_function_start_text.scope: Each exact function start referenced by a .data.rel.ro relative slot is counted once. Some functions also have other references. This measures the addressed machine code, not what would be removed by deleting the slots.

relocation_masked_code.method: Each unique physical function in the final ELF is matched by mangled name and size to its FatLTO input. Hash final linked instructions with only recorded relocation operands zeroed and retain the relocation type/offset list. Groups differ at most in those operands. Choosing one body per group ignores the costs and behavior of carrying the operands, indirect calls, unwind actions and surviving wrappers. This is an optimistic ceiling for this exact shape-sharing strategy, not a saving or a ceiling for all source transformations.

simple_operand_row_estimate.method: For each shape, store eight bytes per varying operand site per distinct operand vector. Constants and duplicate rows within a shape cost zero in this estimate. An implementation may reuse existing type descriptors, index values more compactly or need additional dispatch code, relocation slots and unwind records. This is a representation scenario, not a measured application delta.

training_coverage.scope: Sum the bytes of each sized final ELF function once, joining all of its symbol aliases by exact name against LLVM training records. Remove only LLVM's optional codegen-unit prefix before the semicolon. Counts describe named training functions, not individual instructions in the final image. A zero count does not imply that the feature may be removed. Unmatched records and inlined callees cannot establish cold execution.
